method: Five push approaches; sustained full throttle allowing shift cuts shorter than 0.25 s; one second of pre-action context; 25 m capture margin; maximum 500 m detector lookback. This does not establish safe/optimal action lengths or geometric straightness.
distance_meaning: Lift lead before the median full-push brake onset, not coast length until the LICO brake onset.
outcome_policy: Separate capture envelopes may overlap previous recovery intervals. They must not become additive outcome windows. Frozen scoring boundaries are stored in the session track_zones.json.
promotion_gates: Inspect trajectory/steering and previous-corner recovery before approving early actions.
Sample acceleration from push traces at the actual proposed lift; never clip a long action onto the old 1.5-ratio grid.
Use local response observations at varied doses before authorizing aggressive lifts.
Audit the 8 s and 500 m detector lookback limits when a requested action approaches them.
